mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, including development builds; there is no build type in which it is turned off. This is consistent with the project's recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
